weapon.axe.name: Axe
weapon.axe.description: A large axe. Melee range, 360 degree cleave, consumes no ammo.
weapon.pistol.name: Pistol
weapon.pistol.description: A simple pistol. Fires one fast, accurate projectile per left mouse click.
weapon.shotgun.name: Shotgun
weapon.shotgun.description: A single barrel, pump action shotgun. Fires a small cloud of bullets per left mouse click. The cloud spreads out the further it travels.
weapon.machinegun.name: Machine Gun
weapon.machinegun.description: A small machine gun. Fires a continuous stream of bullets while the left mouse button is held down. Accuracy suffers at long range.
weapon.pipebomb.name: Pipe Bomb
weapon.pipebomb.description: A bomb with a remote detonator. Throw one bomb at a time: the first click throws it, the second click detonates it.
weapon.railgun.name: Rail Gun
weapon.railgun.description: An energy weapon that fires very accurate, very fast projectiles that can pierce through several enemies at once, dealing heavy damage.
weapon.flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
weapon.flamethrower.description: Sprays a stream of fire that slows down and expands as it leaves the gun. Enemies take damage while standing in this fire.
weapon.repair.name: Spanner
weapon.repair.description: A spanner for repairing structures. Consumes no ammo, can hit multiple structures at once. Heals 5 hp per hit.
weapon.rpg.name: RPG
weapon.rpg.description: Fires a single grenade. It damages its target and all enemies in a large area. Damage is most intense in the center of the blast.
weapon.minigun.name: Minigun
weapon.minigun.description: Fires a rapid stream of high velocity bullets. Bullets do heavy damage to single targets.
structure.factory.name: Money Mite Factory
structure.factory.description: Produces a single Money Mite bot. It flies around the arena picking up money for you. Very weak, but very fast.
structure.generator.name: Node
structure.generator.description: A small node which absorbs enemy fire. Nodes heal one another when placed close together.
structure.turret.name: Machinegun Turret
structure.turret.description: A small, cheap, rapid firing turret. Does fair damage, but is very weak.
structure.axe_factory.name: Axe Factory
structure.axe_factory.description: Produces Axebots. Generates 4 bots every 20 seconds. Bots last a maximum of 40 seconds.
structure.cannon.name: Cannon Turret
structure.cannon.description: A large turret firing explosive shells. Heavy damage, moderate health, slow rotation and reload.
structure.command.name: Command Tower
structure.command.description: Controls your robots. Robots under its influence move and attack at twice their normal speed.
structure.pistol_factory.name: Pistol Factory
structure.pistol_factory.description: Produces 4 Pistolbots every 20 seconds. Pistolbots last a maximum of 40 seconds.
structure.laser.name: Laser Turret
structure.laser.description: A long range, accurate tower that deals heavy single target damage. Always targets the furthest enemy.
structure.minigun_turret.name: Minigun Turret
structure.minigun_turret.description: A rapid firing turret with fast minigun bullets. A machinegun turret on steroids.
structure.boss_factory.name: Boss Factory
structure.boss_factory.description: Builds a giant Axebot that splits into smaller Axebots on death. High health, slow construction. Controllable with a Command Tower.
structure.buggy.name: Buggy
structure.buggy.description: A small, fast buggy with an automatic machinegun turret. Short range and low health.
structure.light_tank.name: Light Tank
structure.light_tank.description: A fixed turret tank with a bulletproof front panel and a cannon. Follows the mouse while you stand in it.
structure.juggernaut.name: The Juggernaut
structure.juggernaut.description: A giant tank with 10 cannon turrets, a minigun turret and a bulletproof front. Opens to release clouds of mini Axebots.
armor.1.name: Light Armor
armor.1.description: 200 max health and twice the movement speed. Space teleports you 500 pixels forward. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
armor.2.name: Medium Armor
armor.2.description: 250 max health. Space creates a scorched area that damages enemies. Cooldown: 40 seconds.
armor.3.name: Heavy Armor
armor.3.description: 300 max health and slower acceleration. Space creates four rotating shields for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
arena.1.title: Arena I
arena.1.intro_message: #####This area contains only melee range enemies.#Feel free to try different weapon/structure#combos on them in relative safety.
arena.2.title: Arena II
arena.2.intro_message: #####This area contains ranged enemies only.# You'll have to use a bit more strategy#against these guys. Railgunners aren't stupid.
arena.3.title: Arena III
arena.3.intro_message: #####This area contains only enemies#that use explosive weapons.#They don't like structures
arena.4.title: Arena IV
arena.4.description: mixed enemies; protect the money mites
arena.4.intro_message: #####This area contains no bosses.#The big mites give you money,#try to keep at least one alive
arena.5.title: Arena V
arena.5.description: boss waves and a transforming final boss
arena.5.intro_message: #####This area contains only bosses.# These mites don't move around#the arena like the last ones did.
arena.6.title: Arena VI
arena.6.description: all enemy types and two final juggernauts
arena.6.intro_message: ####This area contains a mixture of all enemies.#Good luck!
